title: A novel Ti–6Al–4V particle-regulated Mg–9Al–1Zn Mg–air battery anode with high discharge stability
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4426-4440
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00642B, Paper
Xin Cao, Jiaxin Zhang, Tao Wang, Feng Zhong, Lin Pi, Xu Cheng, Ming Liang, Jianfeng Li
The effect of micron Ti–6Al–4V particles on the electrochemical properties of Mg–9Al–1Zn composites as an anode of Mg–air batteries was investigated.
